commit.message:
Make tests more robust again (#165)

* use different, hopefully more robust, coordinates for oc_reverse() tests

* reset `oc_rate_sec` option

* Update NEWS [skip CI]

* ~~find~~ escape braces

i.e. double-escape braces in DESCRIPTION so they are not "lost" in the generated package documentation.
cf. https://github.com/r-lib/roxygen2/issues/1578
